title: Finite covering refinement over an affine pro-etale object
statement: Let X be a scheme and W an affine object of its pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Every covering sieve S of W contains a family of arrows indexed by a finite type, and the sieve generated by this family covers W.

source.place: Tags 0935 and 0946; quasi-compact refinement of pro-etale coverings

proof.text: Use stability under composition of the pro-etale precoverage to find a generating covering presieve inside the given covering sieve. Map its canonical pre-zero-hypercover to schemes over W.
The resulting weakly etale scheme cover is a quasi-compact cover. Since the target W is affine and hence quasi-compact, apply QuasiCompactCover.exists_hom to obtain a finite refinement.

Compose the arrows of the refinement with W to view their domains as objects of the pro-etale site of X. The finite scheme cover generates a covering sieve there. Each refined arrow factors through an arrow of the original presieve, so downward closure puts it in S. An empty finite family is allowed when W is empty.

from.place: Finite covering refinement in the finite-support proof

lean.statement:
theorem finite_cover_refinement (X : Scheme.{u}) (W : X.ProEt)
    [IsAffine W.left] (S : Sieve W) (hS : S ∈ topology X W) :
    ∃ (I : Type (u + 1)) (_ : Finite I) (V : I → X.ProEt) (f : ∀ i, V i ⟶ W),
      Sieve.ofArrows V f ∈ topology X W ∧ ∀ i, S (f i)
